annotation.description: Frame-level table-tennis event annotations for OpenTTGames game_2

ground_truth_derivation.rally_window_rule: Each serve defines the start of a candidate rally window extending until the next serve.
ground_truth_derivation.ending_dedup_rule: Adjacent identical ending labels within 2 frames are deduplicated.
ground_truth_derivation.valid_rally_rule: Keep rally windows with exactly one explicit ending after deduplication; six windows with no source terminal use a bounded video-audit terminal, and one window is truncated at an audited cut frame because it spans two points.
